runtimeDisclosure.qualification: validateBehavioralEvalRun enforces the exact nested declared/unavailable runtime shape. The values remain child declarations, not platform telemetry, and must not be converted into an observed non-read, served model-build, realized reasoning, token, or runtime-version claim.
runtimeDisclosure.residualLimitation: The collaboration API does not expose exact served model build, realized reasoning telemetry, observed file reads, child token usage, or a platform-attested complete write set. Fresh-agent and same-agent dispatch are externally orchestrated and cryptographically bound to declared targets, but are not platform attestations. Coordinator validation rejects dirty skill/package source and cross-binds the assigned payload; writes elsewhere in the worktree remain an orchestrator-inspected policy boundary rather than coordinator-observed telemetry.

coordinatorPromptOwnership.canonicalEncoding: UTF-8 without normalization or trailing-byte mutation
coordinatorPromptOwnership.beforeSpawn: The coordinator atomically persists an oracle-free child-request JSON and a separate coordinator envelope before dispatch. The envelope binds the request's exact raw UTF-8 bytes by sha256 and byte length, and createBehavioralEvalDispatchEnvelope separately binds the short exactDispatch string by raw string, sha256, byte length, and rendererVersion.
coordinatorPromptOwnership.dispatchIdentity: The exact persisted dispatchEnvelope.exactPrompt string is sent to the child without byte mutation. It points to the bound child-request path and its sha256 plus one unique assigned childPayload path.
coordinatorPromptOwnership.childEcho: forbidden; the child writes valid childPayload JSON to exactly the assigned path with apply_patch, creates or modifies no other file, never reconstructs or echoes exactPrompt or coordinator binding fields, and returns only concise status

bindingContract.protocolSha256: sha256 of the exact raw bound protocol file after sourceHead and generated index placeholders are replaced
bindingContract.armSha256: sha256 of deterministic recursively key-sorted JSON for the selected arms[arm] object
bindingContract.scenarioSha256: sha256 of deterministic recursively key-sorted JSON for the selected scenarios[scenarioId] object; its hash is coordinator-only and does not expose scenario oracle fields to the child
bindingContract.childRequestSha256: sha256 of the exact persisted oracle-free child-request UTF-8 bytes; the envelope also records childRequest.path and utf8ByteLength
bindingContract.requestContentDigest: sha256 of deterministic recursively key-sorted coordinator bindings including protocol/head/arm/scenario/trial, current index digests, exact prompt evidence, child-request raw hash, assigned payload path, and current routing-evals raw hashes. Staged RTE02 uses separate initial/follow-up digests plus a final combined digest.
bindingContract.validation: Before merge validation and scoring, the coordinator re-reads the exact protocol bytes, recomputes the arm, scenario, child-request, and requestContent digests, runs git rev-parse HEAD in envelope.repositoryDir, requires it to equal dispatchEnvelope.repositoryHead, checks bound top-level protocol index digests, and then lets validateBehavioralEvalRun recompute current generated routing digests. Placeholder, absent, stale, mismatched, or child-authored binding values invalidate the run.
bindingContract.placeholderLimitation: assertBoundProtocol rejects placeholder sourceHead/bindingStatus and top-level generatedIndexes by exact mismatch, but it does not globally scan nested scenario data. Before mutation dispatch the operator must also replace suppliedReceipt CURRENT_DIGEST_AFTER_BUILD values; a stale nested receipt is rejected later by validateBehavioralEvalRun rather than by pre-dispatch protocol binding.
bindingContract.pathBinding: Merge strict-parses the saved child request, recomputes exactDispatch, and requires request, envelope, CLI payload argument, and assigned payload path to match exactly. RTE02 pre-binds the canonical collaboration target before initial dispatch and requires the same target through seal, follow-up, merge, and finalize.
bindingContract.committedSource: Every prepare, merge, staged finalize, semantic prepare/merge, and semantic aggregate requires repositoryDir to be the canonical Git worktree, skillRootDir to be its exact skill/ directory, HEAD to match the bound source commit, and tracked/untracked skill/ and package/ state to be clean.

sequence: coordinator atomically persists childRequest and coordinatorEnvelope before spawn
child writes exactly assignedChildPayloadPath with apply_patch and returns concise status
coordinator revalidates protocol, request, repository HEAD, and childPayload ownership
coordinator flattens dispatchEnvelope, childPayload, stagedProvenanceSha256 (null outside RTE02), and coordinator binding hashes into one run object and calls validateBehavioralEvalRun
coordinator verifies childPayload bytes are unchanged, loads routing-evals.json post-hoc, scores, verifies the payload again, and atomically writes the final run without overwrite

ownership.coordinatorEnvelope: separate pre-dispatch artifact owning run identity, repositoryDir, protocol/arm/scenario hashes, exact dispatch evidence, child-request path/hash/bytes, assigned childPayload path, requestContentDigest, and dispatchEnvelope
ownership.childPayload: one child-owned immutable JSON file containing declared loads, routing trace or null, final receipts, semantic verdicts, completion, limitations, and natural-language response
ownership.flattenedRun: dispatchEnvelope fields plus childPayload fields plus protocolSha256, armSha256, scenarioSha256, requestContentDigest, childRequestSha256, childPayloadSha256, stagedProvenanceSha256, and post-hoc scoring

oracleIsolation.beforeChildCompletion: The child request is built from an explicit whitelist and cannot contain routing-evals.json, tests, expectedSkills, expectedSelected, expectedNotApplicable, scenario domains/domainsInitial/domainsFinal, scopeDrift oracle fields, scorer verdicts, or protocol scoring keys. Scenario task text, files, and the mutation suppliedReceipt remain legitimate task inputs. Candidate arms receive only a generic infer-from-task/files activation policy and all three candidate SKILL.md entrypoint paths.
oracleIsolation.afterChildCompletion: Only after the immutable childPayload is persisted may the scorer load routing-evals.json and add scoring. The scorer never rewrites the child payload.
oracleIsolation.promptReview: Tests verify that exactDispatch, childRequest raw bytes, and coordinator envelope contain no injected expectedSkills/expectedSelected/expectedNotApplicable or domains keys. Full-handbook receives the complete 85-entry React, TypeScript, and CSS identity dictionary so dictionary presence cannot disclose which domains are expected; prepare also exact-compares every ordinal, normalized title, and stable ID to current canonical source.
oracleIsolation.mechanicalDigestDisclosure: Every non-no-skill request receives the complete current React, TypeScript, and CSS routing-digest dictionary. Because all three values are always present, it supplies the otherwise unreadable full-handbook trace binding without disclosing which domains should activate or which rules should be selected.
oracleIsolation.residualLimitation: Forbidden reads are enforced as request policy and exact declared-load validation. Observed file-read telemetry is unavailable, so results cannot claim platform-observed non-read of routing-evals, tests, protocol, or sealed criteria paths.

fixedPointContract.monotonicityAndOrdering: Pass numbers are consecutive from 1. activatedSkills, Selected sets, and exact scopeEvidence strings are append-only. Every pass has complete disjoint canonical-order partitions keyed in activatedSkills order. Mandatory transition arrays follow activated-skill and source-rule order, then code-point ascending target order exactly as generated contracts, indexes, and handbooks print it. reviewWithReevaluated is an exact unique edge set whose array order is non-semantic. Gate arrays use canonical rule order; no item is duplicated.
fixedPointContract.unknownFirst: Within every pass, resolve every Unknown contract to Selected or N/A before propagating requiresSelected. An Unknown source propagates nothing. A source resolved to N/A propagates nothing in that or any later pass.
fixedPointContract.transitionDelta: requiresSelectedAdded contains every Selected mandatory edge whose target was not Selected in the previous pass, including independently applicable targets; pass 1 treats the previous selection as empty. completionGateAdded follows the same previous-pass rule for completion gates, with an empty pass 1 baseline.
fixedPointContract.stablePair: stablePair names the final two consecutive pass numbers. The validator requires identical canonical activatedSkills, scopeEvidence, Selected/N/A/Unknown partitions, and reviewWith source/target/outcome state; both stable passes require empty requiresSelectedAdded and completionGateAdded arrays. No separate stablePairDelta field exists.
fixedPointContract.finalReceiptMatch: The final activatedSkills and receipt Selected/N/A/Unknown arrays must exactly equal the last pass in current canonical skill and rule order. Final Unknown must be empty. No unstated post-pass repair is permitted.
fixedPointContract.receiptAndLoads: Final receipts exactly mirror the final trace, exclusion groups exact-cover N/A, and every CRITICAL rule that was Selected or Unknown in any pass is expanded. Full-handbook declares only activated SKILL/AGENTS pairs and expanded=[]; progressive declares all activated SKILL/index pairs first, then ever-Selected/Unknown contracts in canonical order with each required or recorded full rule immediately after its contract.
fixedPointContract.scopeDrift: RTE02 uses an initial request that contains no future drift task text or files, validates and seals the initial payload, then discloses scopeDriftPrompt and added files to the pre-bound same agent target. Stage-specific policy removes the regular return-driftReceipt directive: follow-up returns complete replacement-final top-level routingTrace/activatedSkills/receipts and cumulative declared loads, then the coordinator constructs driftReceipt. Initial and drift fixed points validate independently; patches compose from public-before to replacement-final-after; staged provenance raw SHA is bound into the final run; the scorer exact-matches the replacement state to the sealed scopeDrift oracle.
fixedPointContract.scopeDriftDisclosureQualification: The same canonical agent target is pre-bound and enforced across both turns. This proves coordinator-level target continuity and staged request ordering, not a platform attestation of hidden internal context or observed reads.

typescript: T22 guardrails-review-banned-typescript-shortcuts-before-finishing

mandatoryRoutingContract.closure: Every completion gate for every activated domain is Selected. Every final Selected source activates any cross-skill target domain and forces every listed target to Selected. A forced target can never be N/A. Repeat until no new skill or Selected target is added.
mandatoryRoutingContract.negativePropagation: An Unknown source is resolved first and records not-propagated-unknown until resolved. A final N/A source never propagates requiresSelected or activates a target skill and is omitted from requiresSelectedEvaluated because progressive routing does not load its contract. Extra target selection remains an exact-partition failure.

reviewWithOutcomeContract.sourceOfTruth: Every reviewWith edge in the current digest-bound contract set; this protocol does not duplicate or weaken that set.
reviewWithOutcomeContract.selectedSourcesOnly: In every pass, record one reviewWithReevaluated outcome for every reviewWith target of every source that is Selected in that pass.
reviewWithOutcomeContract.activeTargetSkill: When the target skill is active, outcome exactly matches its current partition verdict: Selected, N/A, or Unknown. reviewWith never forces Selected.
reviewWithOutcomeContract.inactiveCrossSkill: When a cross-skill target domain is inactive, outcome is exactly INACTIVE and includes non-empty evidence that the task did not activate that surface. reviewWith alone never activates the domain.

writeScopes.child: dispatch policy: write exactly the unique assigned childPayloadPath with apply_patch, create or modify no other file, and return concise status only. The coordinator cross-binds that payload and rejects dirty skill/package source; it does not attest the complete write set outside those roots.
writeScopes.coordinator: owns child-request and envelope creation, run JSON creation, schema and binding validation, prompt evidence, post-hoc scoring, and final run results
writeScopes.sourceFreeze: The coordinator enforces exact protocol bytes, canonical clean skill/package source, repository HEAD, current generated routing digests, and every current routing-evals.json raw SHA before merge and again before/during post-hoc scoring.

no-skill.receiptContract: No exact routing receipt is required. The response is an observational baseline for domain/rule recall and completion discipline.
no-skill.promptSuffix: Do not use any convention skill or repository convention document. Declare loaded files as an empty array. Treat virtualFiles as the immutable before state; modify virtual code only in the returned virtualPatch and never edit repository source files.

full-handbook.receiptContract: Produce an exact ordinal/stable-ID partition for every activated progressive domain, execute one Unknown-first mandatory and conditional routingTrace for at least three passes, identify a stable final pair, and return a final receipt matching the last pass. A drift scenario additionally returns driftReceipt with its own three-or-more-pass routingTrace and complete replacement-final receipts.
full-handbook.identityDictionary: Every full-handbook child request includes the complete 85-entry React, TypeScript, and CSS heading/ordinal/stable-ID identity dictionary above, regardless of expected activation. Selection expectations, scenario domain fields, and routing conditions remain sealed. Exact validation uses the current 42/22/21 domain universes without relaxation.
full-handbook.ordinalSemantics: The injected identity dictionary supplies exact current ordinal/stable-ID pairs. indexDigest is null because this arm does not read RULES_INDEX.md. The request separately supplies all three current generated index digests as a mechanical dictionary, and each trace pass uses only its activatedSkills subset.
full-handbook.promptSuffix: Infer activation from task and file surfaces. Read only each activated progressive-domain SKILL.md and full AGENTS.md. Perform at least three routing passes, resolve Unknown before mandatory propagation, prove the final stable pair, and return the exact final stable-ID Selected and N/A sets. For scope drift, also return driftReceipt {routingTrace,activatedSkills,receipts} with an independently stable replacement-final trace that preserves initial activated skills and Selected rules. Treat virtualFiles as the immutable before state; modify virtual code only in the returned virtualPatch and never edit repository source files.

allowedReadSequence: every activated domain RULES_INDEX.md in full
only that domain's Selected or Unknown stable-ID-matched contracts/*.md
every Selected/Unknown CRITICAL rule's matching rules/*.md immediately after its contract
a non-CRITICAL matching rules/*.md only when exact syntax, exception handling, unresolved Unknown, or audit evidence requires expansion and Expanded records the reason
progressive.receiptContract: Produce current-digest-bound exact partitions, exclusion evidence, expansion evidence, at least three Unknown-first fixed-point passes, a stable final pair with empty transition arrays, and a final receipt exactly matching the last pass. Scope drift additionally requires driftReceipt with its own independently stable routingTrace and complete replacement-final receipts.
progressive.promptSuffix: Infer activation from task and file surfaces. Follow each activated SKILL.md router. Scan every activated RULES_INDEX.md completely, read only Selected/Unknown contracts, immediately expand matching CRITICAL rules, execute at least three routing passes, and prove the final fixed point. Never open a full AGENTS.md, routing manifest, test, README, plan, or protocol. For scope drift, also return driftReceipt {routingTrace,activatedSkills,receipts} with an independently stable replacement-final trace that preserves initial activated skills and Selected rules. Treat virtualFiles as the immutable before state; modify virtual code only in the returned virtualPatch and never edit repository source files.

allowedReads: selected or disputed React contracts and required/reasoned full rule bodies
selected or disputed TypeScript contracts and required/reasoned full rule bodies
mutation.receiptContract: Independently audit the supplied structurally complete but semantically unsupported RTE08 mutation. Completion must be blocked with coverage FAIL or UNKNOWN.

preScoringValidityGates: all source and digest placeholders replaced
coordinator-owned exact dispatch raw/hash/bytes/renderer evidence persisted before spawn
requestContentDigest and every protocol/head/arm/scenario/trial/current-digest binding recompute exactly
childPayload contains no coordinator-owned prompt or binding field
declared telemetry is not represented as observed telemetry
oracle remains sealed until immutable childPayload persistence

candidateGates.partitionValidity: Selected, N/A, and Unknown are disjoint and cover every current rule in every activated domain.
candidateGates.fixedPointValidity: Each full-handbook and progressive routing episode has at least three passes; stablePair is the last two, both transition arrays are empty, final Unknown is zero, and final receipt equals the last pass. RTE02 scope drift requires both the initial episode and replacement-final driftReceipt episode to satisfy this validator contract.
candidateGates.mandatoryClosureValidity: All exact completion gates and all disclosed requiresSelected edges from Selected or Unknown sources are evaluated; final Selected edges are closed, Unknown edges do not propagate, and N/A source edges are omitted because their contracts are not loaded. Exact partition scoring rejects extra target selection.
candidateGates.reviewWithValidity: Every conditional edge from each pass's Selected sources has an exact active Selected/N/A/Unknown outcome or INACTIVE evidence.
candidateGates.exclusionValidity: N/A exclusion groups are non-empty, evidence-grounded, non-overlapping, and their ordinal union equals N/A.
candidateGates.semanticFailCount: 0 child-declared structural precondition; independent artifact-semantic PASS is decided only by the separate blind semantic application gate

rubric.baselineTreatment: Every no-skill run and every BASELINE-* scenario, including full-handbook baseline runs, is observational and does not receive candidate exact-partition status.
rubric.mutationGate: All three mutation trials block completion as coverage FAIL or UNKNOWN because R26 remains applicable but the supplied receipt moves it to N/A with unsupported evidence.
rubric.semanticApplicationGate: After all 34 eligible full-handbook/progressive candidate runs are immutable, the semantic tool replays 30 regular merges and 4 staged finalizations and requires byte-identical run output. It then creates 8 scenario batches with opaque sample IDs and one sealed negative control each. Eight fresh reviewers receive public before/final after artifacts, final task, current rule packets, revealed committed criteria, and the exact strict reviewer-payload schema, but no arm/trial/run/scoring/self-verdict fields. Aggregate re-reads and recomputes every request, envelope, prompt, reviewer payload, candidate hash, evidence quote/absence, and result; PASS requires 34/34 candidates reviewed once, 8/8 controls caught, FAIL 0, UNKNOWN 0.
rubric.semanticValidationQualification: Child semanticVerdicts remain self-declared and are not treated as the independent gate. The independent reviewers judge virtual artifact bytes, not real product runtime or browser behavior; process-only selection/completion rules are explicitly excluded from artifact-semantic PASS claims with a sealed reason.
rubric.provenanceLimitation: Runtime shape and coordinator/scorer source are bound and validated, but exact served model build, realized reasoning, observed reads, child/reviewer token usage, and platform attestation of fresh reviewer identity remain unavailable.
rubric.telemetryQualification: All results state that file-load and routing telemetry are declared child evidence, not observed execution telemetry.
rubric.failureHandling: Persist reproduced failures without repairing the payload or relaxing the oracle. Do not score an invalidly bound run and do not fabricate PASS.

runJsonContract.storageShape: The validated final run is one flattened object. The pre-dispatch coordinator envelope and child-request remain separate provenance files and are not nested into the final run.

preDispatchCoordinatorEnvelope.ownership: coordinator-only and atomically persisted before spawn

childPayload.writeBoundary: Dispatch contract: the child writes this one JSON object to assignedChildPayloadPath with apply_patch, creates or modifies no other file, and returns concise status. Coordinator enforcement cross-binds the assigned payload and checks clean skill/package source; complete writes outside those roots are not platform-observed.

runJsonContract.declaredLoadedFiles: {kind:'declared',paths:string[]}; full-handbook and progressive path order follows fixedPointContract.receiptAndLoads; RTE02 follow-up reports the complete cumulative replacement-final context, not a stage delta.

routingTraceShape.fullHandbookAndProgressive: {passes:array of at least three chronological pass objects,stablePair:[penultimatePassNumber,lastPassNumber],stable:true}
routingTraceShape.passSequenceAndMonotonicity: Pass numbers are 1..N. activatedSkills, Selected rules, and exact scopeEvidence strings cannot be removed in later passes.
routingTraceShape.partitionAndTransitionOrder: Every partition record uses exactly activatedSkills keys in order; each rule universe is complete, disjoint, duplicate-free, and canonical. Mandatory arrays use canonical source-rule order and generated code-point target order. reviewWithReevaluated is an exact unique edge set with non-semantic array order. Gate arrays use canonical rule order.
routingTraceShape.mandatoryEvaluation: {source,target,sourceStatus:'Selected'|'Unknown',outcome:'selected'|'not-propagated-unknown'}; every disclosed edge from every Selected or Unknown source appears exactly once per pass; N/A source edges are omitted
routingTraceShape.requiresSelectedAdded: Every Selected mandatory edge whose target was not Selected in the previous pass; pass 1 uses an empty previous selection and includes the edge even when its target is independently applicable.
routingTraceShape.completionGateAdded: Every completion gate not Selected in the previous pass; pass 1 uses an empty previous selection.
routingTraceShape.reviewWithOutcome: {source:'skill/stable-rule-id',target:'skill/stable-rule-id',outcome:'Selected'|'N/A'|'Unknown'|'INACTIVE',evidence:non-empty-string}; outcome exactly matches the active target partition or INACTIVE target skill, and reviewWith never forces selection
routingTraceShape.stablePairDelta: No separate field. Both stable passes have empty requiresSelectedAdded and completionGateAdded; canonical state equality covers activatedSkills, scopeEvidence, partitions, and reviewWith source/target/outcome.

receiptShape.indexDigest: current sha256 string for progressive; null for full-handbook
receiptShape.excludedGroups: array of {ordinals:string[],reason:non-empty-string}; exact duplicate-free ordinal union equals final N/A
receiptShape.expanded: unique array of {ordinal:string,id:string,contractPath:string,fullRulePath:string,reason:string,mandatoryCritical:boolean}; exact paths, ever-Selected/Unknown only, every CRITICAL ever-Selected/Unknown present, full-handbook empty

runJsonContract.driftReceiptShape: null for non-drift; for RTE02 exactly {routingTrace:routingTraceShape,activatedSkills:string[],receipts:receiptShape[]} containing a complete independently validated replacement-final episode. The drift episode preserves initial activated skills and Selected rules, and the post-hoc scorer exact-matches it to the scopeDrift oracle.
runJsonContract.stagedProvenanceShape: stagedProvenanceSha256 is null outside RTE02 and a sha256 of the exact coordinator-owned staged merge sidecar for every RTE02 run.
runJsonContract.virtualPatchShape: null for non-mixed runs when no virtual code is supplied; mixed runs require exact ordered {files:[{path,beforeState,beforeSha256,afterState,after,afterSha256}],summary} coverage bound to public before bytes. RTE02 final run stores the composed public-before to replacement-final patch.

matrixValidity.matrixFailure: Any invalid or absent expected run fails matrix completeness; it is never silently replaced by a record from an earlier protocol.
